category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, reduce dropout to 0.05 and learning rate to 4e-4: less dropout may improve fitting at width 48, while smaller updates may stabilize training. Retain six causal blocks and all other settings. Existing metadata and predictor loading remain compatible.

change_summary: Jointly lower NextItNet dropout and learning rate for all four independent category models, preserving architecture, routing, seeds and training limits.
